Shrink and adjustments

Counts and adjustments by reason. Shrink is every unit lost to damage, expiry, theft or a count coming up short.

Shrink by department and category

Store

The catalog holds 19,416 active items from the Test Store 001 item file (Aug 29, 2026), all starting at zero on hand. Unit cost and retail defaults come from that file and can be overridden on each receipt.

Backup and archive

The live database holds up to 25,000 records. Archiving saves every ticket to a backup file on this device, rolls old tickets into a stock balance, then removes them from the live list. On-hand quantities, last costs and vendor totals stay exactly the same.

Restoring replaces everything on this device with the backup file. Use it to set up a new device or move a store's data.
